title: Fix OpenAI provider silently saved as Ollama (data corruption)
description:
Fix OpenAI provider silently saved as Ollama (data corruption) (Council-refined)

Problem: Provider normalization code saves an incorrect provider id to DB in some error-paths; this causes provider mismatch at runtime and unexpected 503s.

Acceptance criteria:
- Centralize provider normalization and persist only validated provider ids
- Add a DB constraint or validation layer preventing invalid provider strings from being stored
- Add migration script to detect and correct existing corrupt entries (report-only by default)

Effort: 4-8h
